reason: A DeepSeek Harness interface panel for browsing, filtering, inspecting, configuring, uninstalling, and grouping agent skills, with documented filesystem mutations and persistent group management.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供用于浏览、筛选、查看、启用或禁用、卸载及分组管理智能体技能的设置与侧边栏面板。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness settings and sidebar panel for browsing, filtering, inspecting, enabling or disabling, uninstalling, and grouping agent skills.

capabilities: Browse and search session-scoped agent skills
View skill metadata and SKILL.md contents
Rewrite skill invocation and disabled-state frontmatter
Create, rename, delete, and manage membership of persisted skill groups
Register settings, sidebar, and overlay user-interface entries
